topics.title: Nature and essential features of partnership

concepts.learning_objective: State the definition of partnership under Section 4 of the Indian Partnership Act 1932 and identify its essential features.
Explain mutual agency and the unlimited, joint and several liability of partners.

topics.title: Partnership deed and provisions of the Partnership Act

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the nature and usual contents of a partnership deed.
Apply the provisions of the Indian Partnership Act 1932 that govern accounts when the deed is silent.
Prepare partners' capital and current accounts under the fixed capital method.
Prepare partners' capital accounts under the fluctuating capital method and distinguish it from the fixed capital method.
Identify the items shown in the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account and compute the divisible profit.
Record the journal entries for appropriations of profit among partners.
Calculate interest on capital allowing for additions to and withdrawals of capital during the year.
Explain how interest on capital is treated when the firm earns insufficient profit or incurs a loss.
Calculate interest on fixed drawings made monthly or quarterly using the average period.
Calculate interest on varying drawings using the product method.

topics.title: Guarantee of profit to a partner

concepts.learning_objective: Distribute profit when a minimum profit guaranteed to a partner is borne by the other partners in an agreed ratio.
Distribute profit when the guarantee of minimum profit is given by one partner alone.
Identify omissions that need past adjustments and the ways of rectifying them.
Prepare a statement of net effect and pass a single adjustment entry in partners' capital accounts.
